description: This Java class models a digital product entity in an e-commerce system, including its database mappings and relationships.

classes.name: DigitalProduct
classes.description: Entity class representing a digital product file associated with a product in the catalog.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the digital product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the digital product.

methods.name: getProductFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the digital product.

methods.name: setProductFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the digital product.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product entity with this digital product.
